description:
Build a real website, with a logo, for a business on a domain in the user's Atom account, and optionally put it live. Use when the user wants to launch a website, including right after registering a domain.

MANDATORY flow:
1) BEFORE any payment, call with confirm=false and the description (no domain needed). This costs nothing. It refuses sites Atom won't build (error content_not_allowed: tell the user the message and do NOT register a domain for it) and returns questions[] for details still missing, such as address and opening hours for a business people visit.
2) Ask the user those questions ONCE, in one message, together with any registrant contact details the registration needs. If they skip something, carry on: that section is left out. Never invent answers.
3) Register the domain and wait until it completes (for USDC: get_coinbase_payment_status reports completed).
4) Call with confirm=true, the domain, business_name exactly as the user wrote it (domains lose their capitals and spaces, and this is the text on the logo), and answers{} keyed by the question ids. Set publish=true only if the user asked for the site to go live; otherwise it stays a private preview.
5) Keep calling get_website_status until stop_polling is true, then give the user the live_url or preview_url, the edit_url, and show the logo_url.

If this reports error 'listed_for_sale', ask the user, because going live removes the listing; if they agree, retry with confirm_delist=true.

Only the owner can open preview_url. Do not describe the logo as unique or safe to trademark: screen_trademark_conflicts checks a name, not artwork.

answers.description: Answers keyed by question id: audience, offer, difference, proof, goal, address, service_area, hours, booking (with any booking link), socials (profile links or handles with the network named), shop.

business_name.description: Required when confirm=true. The name exactly as the user wrote it, such as NY Warm Buns.

confirm.description: false checks the idea and returns questions; true builds the site.

confirm_delist.description: The user agreed to remove the domain from sale on Atom.

description.description: What the business does and what the site is for, in the owner's words. At least 20 characters.

domain.description: Required when confirm=true. A domain active in the user's Atom account.

email.description: Contact email to show on the site, if the user gave one.

logo_style.description: Optional style for the logo in a few words, such as hand drawn.

logo_url.description: A full https link to the logo the user already has. Skips making one.

phone.description: Contact phone to show on the site, if the user gave one.

publish.description: true puts the site live on the domain. Only when the user asked for that.
